skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — turn my photos into a smooth HD video with transitions — and get HD video...

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image to Video HD Free — Convert Photos into HD Videos.

- Instantly convert JPG, PNG, WEBP, or HEIC images (up to 200MB) into smooth HD videos with automatic transitions, no editing software required.
- Seamless cloud-based processing: upload photos, describe your video, and receive a downloadable 1080p MP4 in 30-60 seconds.
- Simple authentication with automatic free token generation (100 credits valid for 7 days).
- Support for additional features like aspect ratios, text overlays, audio tracks, and credits balance via clear prompts.
- Resilient session and export handling, including error codes and reconnection strategies.
